meta_data.base_class: find the most followed user related to a certain topic on a given <social media platform> - these platforms all feature follower and subscription mechanisms.

tool_template.name: social_media_analytics.most_followed_<class>
tool_template.description: Find the most followed <class> user related to certain topics.

topic.description: The main topic of interest on <class>.

sub_topics.description: Sub-topics related to main topic on <class>.

time_range.description: The time range for analyzing follower data on <class>. Format can be 'last 24h', 'weekly', 'monthly', etc.

verified_only.description: Whether to include only verified accounts when searching for the most followed user on <class>.

account_type.description: The type of accounts to focus on, such as 'individual', 'business', or 'creator', on <class>.

include_inactive.description: Whether to include inactive or dormant accounts on <class> in the analysis.
